idea-plugin.name: Markdown Link Keeper
idea-plugin.description:
Keeps your Markdown links working when files move.

When you move or rename a file, this plugin automatically updates every relative Markdown link that pointed to it, across the whole project. The change is a single undoable command, so one Ctrl+Z reverts it.

The bundled Markdown support only highlights a broken link once you open the file that contains it. In a documentation set with hundreds of pages, moving one file silently breaks links scattered everywhere.

  • Automatic link updates on file move and rename
  • Project-wide scan listing every link that points to a missing file
  • Never touches external URLs, mailto links, anchors, or fenced code blocks

搬檔案時，自動修好所有指向它的 Markdown 連結。

內建的 Markdown 支援只會在你打開某個檔案時標出壞連結。一個上百份文件的 專案，搬動一個檔案會弄壞散落各處的連結，而你不會知道。

  • 檔案搬移或改名時，自動更新所有指向它的相對連結（可用 Ctrl+Z 復原）
  • 一鍵掃描全專案，列出所有指向不存在檔案的連結
  • 絕不動到外部網址、mailto、錨點，以及程式碼區塊裡的連結
